Service area questions.

Which Chicago neighborhoods does CenterPoint serve?

We serve 29 Chicago neighborhoods, from Rogers Park and Edgewater on the North Side through Lincoln Park, the Gold Coast, River North, the Loop, and the West Loop to Hyde Park and Kenwood. See the Chicago service area.

Which suburbs does CenterPoint serve?

We serve 14 North Shore and nearby suburbs, including Evanston, Skokie, Wilmette, Winnetka, Glenview, Northbrook, Highland Park, and Lake Forest. See the North Shore and suburbs page.

Our community is not listed. Can you still help?

Possibly. We consider associations near our service area case by case. Call 773.728.0652 or send us a few details.

Do Chicago and suburban associations follow different rules?

Often, yes. Chicago adds its own building, facade, and heat ordinances, and some suburbs, such as Evanston, add local requirements on top of state law. Each neighborhood page covers what managing there actually takes.

Tell us about your association.

Share a few details and we will follow up to schedule a conversation with your board. No cost, no obligation.
